{{Quote|We'll be disassembled, cannibalized for scrap, sent to the sandmines of Neelgaimon or the orbital factories around Ryloon!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="CJ" />}}
'''Neelgaimon''' was a forsaken [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Xappyh sector/Legends|Xappyh sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. At the time, following the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the planet was infamous for its sandmines. Several designers of the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'' battlemoon were reassigned to punitive duty in the sandmines on Neelgaimon after the ship was [[Ismaren plot|destroyed]].

==Description==
Neelgaimon was a terrestrial<ref name="RG" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="CE">{{CSWECite|II|367|Neelgaimon}}</ref> located in the [[Neelgaimon system/Legends|eponymous star system]], a part of the [[Xappyh sector/Legends|Xappyh sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Neelgaimon was infamous beyond the planet<ref name="CJ" /> for its sandmines.<ref name="CJ" /><ref name="CE" />

==History==
{{Quote|Real vacation spots|Han Solo|<ref name="CJ" />}}
At some point, alongside [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] and [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] visited Neelgaimon. By the time following the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="CJ" /> Neelgaimon was forsaken<ref name="CE" /> and notorious for<ref name="CJ" /> its sandmines.<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CE" /> In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> several<ref name="SWE" /> high-ranking designers of artificial intelligence constructs and automated weapons systems involved in the creation of the ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'' battlemoon<ref name="CJ" /> were reassigned to punitive duty in the sandmines on Neelgaimon<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CE" /> after the ship failed to [[Ismaren plot|destroy]] a [[Plawal Rift|Jedi enclave]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="CJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Neelgaimon was first mentioned<ref name="CJ" /> in the [[1995]] novel [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']], written by [[Barbara Hambly]].<ref name="ERC" /> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Neelgaimon system/Legends|Neelgaimon star system]] and the object itself in grid square J-5.<ref name="EAOC" />

The planet appears to be a [[Tuckerization]] of the name of the British writer [[wikipedia:Neil Gaiman|Neil Gaiman]]. [[Barbara Hambly]], author of ''[[Children of the Jedi]]'', also included another Tuckerization of Neil Gaiman's name in the character [[Gayman Neeloid]], in her second ''Star Wars'' novel, ''[[Planet of Twilight]]''.
